## About

Mathieu Waharte is a Fullstack Engineer & AI enthusiast based in Paris. He builds comprehensive web applications and integrates AI solutions into real-world projects.

## Projects

### How Europe Spends Its Time

**Period**: Mar 2026 – Apr 2026  
**Organization**: Polytech Paris-Saclay  
**Summary**: Resolved severe codification drift across 20 years of European time-use surveys with resilient Python mapping pipelines, then designed an accessible web app with custom interactive charts for a Hugging Face dataset.  
**Stack**: Python, pandas, Data Visualization, Accessibility, Hugging Face  
**Links**:
- [Dataset on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Bluefir/hetus-time-use)
- [Case Study](/projects/how-europe-spends-its-time)

### Deloitte x Google Cloud Hackathon

**Period**: Nov 2025  
**Organization**: Deloitte x Google Cloud  
**Status**: Won  
**Summary**: Built a distributed multi-agent system with ADK and MCP to automate marketing campaign creation, orchestrating specialized agents via A2A and integrating BigQuery, Gemini, Imagen, Cloud Run, and Vertex AI Agent Engine.

### XTTS Finetuning

**Period**: Jun 2025 – Aug 2025  
**Organization**: L-Università ta' Malta  
**Summary**: Reviewed the state of the art in TTS, built a Streamlit app for faster paper discovery, and fine-tuned XTTS on Google Colab with PyTorch and GPT-2 to add Maltese without regressions.  
**Stack**: Git, PyTorch, GPT-2, XTTS, Streamlit, Hugging Face  
**Links**:
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Wubpooz/Malta-TTS)
